items.answer: The documents do not specify the date when the Hall 3 chiller failed. However, they mention that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026 [1].

evidence.quote: the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026

items.question: When did Voss-Lindqvist accept the Calder & Wynne engagement letter?
items.answer: The documents do not specify when Voss-Lindqvist accepted the Calder & Wynne engagement letter. However, they indicate that Petra Voss, as General Counsel for Voss-Lindqvist AB, accepted the letter on 7 February 2026 [2].

evidence.quote: Accepted for Voss-Lindqvist AB by Petra Voss on 7 February 2026 (fictional)

items.question: What must Harrowgate maintain to protect information under the MSA?
items.answer: The documents state that Harrowgate must maintain an information-security programme no less protective than ISO/IEC 27001 to protect information under the MSA [3].

evidence.quote: Provider shall maintain an information-security programme no less protective than ISO/IEC 27001

items.question: Whose consent does the tenant need to assign the whole warehouse lease?
items.answer:
The Tenant needs the Landlord's consent to assign the whole warehouse lease. The relevant clause states: "The Tenant may assign the whole of the Premises with the Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld" [1].

There is no indication that any other party's consent is required for the assignment.

evidence.quote: The Tenant may assign the whole of the Premises with the Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld
